bib.title: DREAMLLM: SYNERGISTIC MULTIMODAL COMPREHENSION AND CREATION

question: Can an MLLM learn to both comprehend and generate raw images and interleaved documents end to end, so that creation and comprehension improve each other?
hypothesis: Learning image and text posteriors in raw space (not aligned to CLIP) on interleaved documents yields synergy between creation and comprehension.
contributions: DREAMLLM: MLLM that generates raw language and images by direct sampling, with learnable dream queries conditioning a frozen Stable Diffusion via score distillation
Interleaved generative pretraining (I-GPT) with a <dream> token that decides where images go
First MLLM that generates free-form interleaved content, with analysis of creation-comprehension synergy

method.summary: Vicuna-7B with frozen CLIP-L/14 encoder (linear projector) as input and frozen SDv2.1 as image decoder, conditioned on 64 learnable dream queries through a linear condition projector. The <dream> token predicts image positions; the diffusion noise-prediction loss on the frozen SD (score distillation) backpropagates into the LLM, queries and projectors. Three stages: alignment, I-GPT pretraining, SFT.
method.task: unified multimodal comprehension and text/interleaved-document image generation

datasets.name: Stage I alignment mix (LLaVAPretrain 558K, BLIP-LAION 8M, LAION400M 11M, LAION-COCO 11M)
SFT: LLaVAInstruct, InstructMMC4, Instruct-BLIP-LAION
datasets.source: InstructMMC4 and Instruct-BLIP-LAION built by prompting GPT-4

datasets.name: MS-COCO val-30K, LN-COCO, held-out InstructMMC4 (15K docs)
COCO, Image2Paragraph, VQAv2, OKVQA, VizWiz, TextVQA, MMBench, MM-Vet, POPE, PIQA, SIQA, HellaSwag, WinoGrande, BoolQ, MMLU

models.name: DREAMLLM-7B
models.architecture: decoder-only LLM + CLIP-L/14 encoder + SDv2.1 decoder, 64 dream queries

models.name: Emu-13B/14B, GILL-8B, CM3Leon-7B, Flamingo-9B, LLaVA, InstructBLIP, MiniGPT-4 etc.

training.objective: Autoregressive MLE over text tokens plus denoising score-matching loss ||eps_xi(z_t; C, t) - eps||^2 on frozen SD conditioned on dream-query outputs (Eqs. 3-6)

other.stage_I_trainable: linear visual projector, linear condition projector, dream queries; LLM, CLIP and SD frozen

inference.samples: MS-COCO FID: 8 images per prompt ranked by CLIP score; LN-COCO: 1 image per prompt
inference.prompting: Prompt templates per task in Fig 9, with system prompt 'A chat between a curious user and an artificial intelligence assistant...'

metrics.name: CIDEr / VQA acc / MMBench / MM-Vet / POPE
metrics.definition: see Table 14; MM-Vet GPT-4 eval, MMBench GPT-3.5 eval

eval.protocol: Zero-shot; single run, no seeds reported; human evaluation by five volunteers on 150 samples.

prompts.text: Please provide an accurate answer within one word.

results.claim: DREAMLLM-7B reaches zero-shot FID 8.46 on MS-COCO, beating Emu-13B (11.66), GILL-8B (12.20), CM3Leon-7B (10.82) and the SDv2.1 decoder alone (12.43).
results.setup: Zero-shot, SDv2.1 frozen decoder, 7B Vicuna; 8 images sampled per prompt, CLIP-score ranking; CFG scale 2.0 on MS-COCO. Lower is better.

results.claim: On LN-COCO (long captions) DREAMLLM-7B gets FID 20.53 against 34.26 for SDv2.1.
results.setup: Zero-shot, one image per prompt, no CLIP ranking (text exceeds CLIP length limit).

results.claim: After stage-I alignment alone the FID already improves over SD by 3.67 (MS-COCO) and 11.83 (LN-COCO); after full training 3.97 and 13.73.
results.setup: Stage-I alignment only (30M pairs); MS-COCO. LN-COCO reduction 11.83.
results.quote: reducing the score by 3.67 and 11.83 on MS-COCO and LN-COCO, respectively

results.claim: DREAMLLM-7B beats Emu-13B on MS-COCO FID by 3.20.
results.quote: surpasses Emu-13B by a significant 3.20 FID on MS-COCO

results.claim: Ablation: joint learning gives best comprehension (MM-Vet 35.9, VQAv2 56.6) vs comprehension-only 34.4 / 54.3 (with L_align) and 31.0 / 55.1 (without); evidence of creation-comprehension synergy, but gains are small and from single runs.
results.setup: Same DREAMLLM architecture and training data; Joint-learning (line 5) with interleaved data and L_align off vs Comprehension-only baselines.

results.claim: Adding a CLIP alignment loss L_align to DREAMLLM makes training fail to converge (collapse).
results.setup: Table 3 line 6, Joint-learning with L_align and interleaved data: MM-Vet, VQAv2, COCO all N/A.
results.quote: our DREAMLLM fails to converge but rather ends in a collapsing point

results.claim: Creation-only training with LLM-conditioned queries reaches FID 8.50; with L_align 8.57.
results.setup: Table 3 line 1 Creation-only, no interleaved data, no L_align.

results.claim: DREAMLLM-7B scores MMBench dev 49.9 overall (58.2 with LLaVA-1.5 SFT data) and MM-Vet 35.9 (36.6 with SFT data).
results.setup: Zero-shot, MMBench dev set, GPT-3.5 evaluation; 7B Vicuna.
results.note: Abstract/intro print MMBench as 49.1 ('49.1/35.9'); Tables 1 and 5 print 49.9.

results.claim: VQAv2 zero-shot 56.6 for DREAMLLM-7B, +16.6 over Emu-13B (40.0).
results.quote: achieving +16.6 higher accuracy on VQAv2 compared to Emu-13B

results.claim: Dream-query count ablation: 64 queries give FID 8.46, 32 give 9.56, 128 give 14.24.
results.setup: Number of learnable <dream> queries; zero-shot MS-COCO 30K.

results.claim: Compared with a rewrite-then-generate baseline (LLM outputs text between <dream> tokens, off-the-shelf SD), DREAMLLM is better at COCO FID (8.46 vs 11.91) and slightly better on VQAv2 (56.6 vs 54.2).
results.setup: Baseline trained on modified MMC4, only text output, no image decoder in training, 7B.

results.claim: Image synthesis from a document: FID 36.62 vs 74.77 for SD on 15K held-out InstructMMC4 documents.
results.setup: 15K documents over 30 MMC4 topics, 500 per topic; each image generated from the matching ground-truth text.
results.quote: our DREAMLLM significantly outperforms SD with an FID score of 36.62

results.claim: Human evaluation: 60.68% of DREAMLLM-generated documents judged supported vs 77.24% for ground-truth MMC4.
results.setup: 150 samples (5 per topic) mixed with ground-truth, five volunteers.
results.note: Text calls 60.68% 'surpassing the 30% Turing test requirement'; small panel, unspecified rubric.
results.quote: our DREAMLLM model achieves a supportive rate of 60.68%

results.claim: Inference latency over SD is marginal: 3.65s vs 3.46s at 50 diffusion steps.
results.setup: NVIDIA A800; 50 steps; latency dominated by the U-Net.

results.claim: Language ability is mostly retained after multimodal training, but MMLU drops from 45.0 (Vicuna-7B) to 41.8.
POPE adversarial accuracy 72.63 for DREAMLLM-7B vs 72.10 for InstructBLIP-14B.
results.table: Table 7, Adversarial, row DREAMLLM-7B (Ours), column Accuracy

results.claim: Training cost: stage I about 6h, stage II about 10h, stage III about 1.5h on 128 A800.

limits: Only 7B LLM tested; scaling to 65B/130B untried.
MMC4 data is noisy (ads), harming output style; image consistency across generated images is weak.
Prompt sensitivity; VQA needs tailored prompts for short answers.
Fails on multi-image compositional prompts ('A and B' becomes 'A like B').
Synergy evidence is small ablation deltas from single runs, no seeds or variance; MMLU falls 3.2 points.
Image quality bounded by frozen SDv2.1 decoder; human-eval rubric unspecified.
